rows.section: Tariff rules (Valais)
rows.label: Married couples and single parents
rows.value: Married couples and single parents living with children or supported persons: the cantonal income tax is reduced by 35%, at least CHF 680 and at most CHF 4,900 (art. 32 al. 3 let. a LF, amounts indexed from 2025)

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Sion; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier
rows.value: No multiple: the tariff gives the cantonal tax (ESTV note 3)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Sion; other communes in Valais set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

rows.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.

rows.section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer (Valais)
rows.label: Cantonal property tax on real estate of legal entities
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
